content:
## Short answer

**Invoice Home makes nice invoice PDFs. Templates are not a trade workflow.**

Fair review: if you need a branded document occasionally, Invoice Home (and tools like it) do that job. If you are a cleaner or [handyman](/for-handymen) with weekly volume, the pain is capturing the job and getting paid — not picking a prettier layout.

Comparison: [SMASH vs Invoice Home](/vs-invoice-home) · Same cluster: [Invoice Simple](/blog/invoice-simple-review-for-tradies) · [Invoice2go](/blog/invoice2go-review-for-tradies) · [Word vs Excel vs app](/blog/word-vs-excel-vs-app-for-invoices).

## What Invoice Home does well

- **Templates and branding** — the PDF looks like a business
- **Low barrier** — freelancers land here from “free invoice template” searches
- **Fine for rare billing** — one-off or monthly invoices without a complex stack

## Pain points people search for

| Pain | Search intent | Need |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Still using Word/Excel | free invoice template / invoice home review | Better PDF |
| Slow after every job | invoice from phone / send invoice fast | Workflow |
| Looking to switch | invoice home alternative | Process tool |
| On-site quote | estimate before I leave | Driveway send |

Template traffic *is* switcher traffic. Many of those people are our ICP — they just do not know they need a loop yet.

## Where templates break

1. **Rebuild every job** — rates live in your head; you retype
2. **No dirty-hands capture** — laptop/form energy
3. **PDF ≠ approve ≠ paid** — the money loop is elsewhere

[Voice to invoice](/voice-invoicing) is the upgrade path: talk → verify catalog → send → they approve → they pay.

## At a glance

| Need | Invoice Home | Busy service businesses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pretty PDF | Strong | — |
| Occasional invoice | Strong | — |
| Weekly trade volume | Weak | Process tool |
| On-site estimate | Weak | ~30s voice |
| Full money loop | Weak | Built-in |

## Keep / switch

**Keep** if you bill rarely and only need a template. **Look past** if Sunday admin is the real cost — same story as [Zoho Invoice](/vs-zoho-invoice) and [Wave](/blog/wave-invoicing-review-for-tradies).

## Bottom line

Invoice Home is honest about being a document tool. Our ICP usually needs a **process**. Pick for the problem you have.
